selection.ownership: Goody (ongoody.com), United States. Reviewed edition is production api.ongoody.com, not api.sandbox.ongoody.com.

research.searchCoverage: Official Goody developer overview, Bearer authentication, /v1/me, products, orders, and workspaces, SOC 2 Type 2 security page, and dated incident search (Goody ongoody + security breach/incident, excluding GoDaddy) reviewed on 2026-09-13. No qualifying Goody platform incident found in reviewed coverage, without a breach-free claim.
Official production host is https://api.ongoody.com with Authorization: Bearer. Dated incident search did not identify a Goody (ongoody.com) data compromise.
research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

adaptations: Credential-only healthcheck maps to documented GET /v1/me. Sandbox host is not used. Native omits the upstream user-agent.

page (min 1) and per_page (1–100) bind to documented query names. Optional country_code and use_custom_catalog are passed through. Official country_code is a 2-letter code; native schema uses minLength 2 because maxLength is not a supported strict-generated constraint. Returns raw {data, list_meta} JSON under data.
id is URL-encoded as a path segment. Optional use_custom_catalog is sent as a query flag. Returns raw product JSON under data.
page and per_page bind to documented query names. created_at[after]/[before] filters are omitted because they are not required for a useful list. Order writes are omitted.
GET /v1/orders/{id}. id is a required non-empty string.
POST /v1/orders/{id}/cancel with an empty body.
POST /v1/orders/{id}/update_expiration with expiration.
Returns raw GET /v1/workspaces JSON under data. No input is required.
GET /v1/order_batches with optional page and per_page.
GET /v1/order_batches/{id}.
POST /v1/order_batches with from_name, send_method, recipients, and cart.
Commerce user payment-method create is omitted.
GET /v1/order_batches/{id}/orders.
GET /v1/order_batches/{id}/recipients.
POST /v1/order_batches/price with send_method, recipients, and cart.
GET /v1/brands with optional page, per_page, and country_code.
GET /v1/cards with optional page and per_page.
GET /v1/collections with optional page, per_page, and published.
GET /v1/collections/{id}.
GET /v1/payment_methods. Commerce user payment-method POST is omitted.
GET /v1/order_activities with optional page, per_page, after, before, and statuses.
EventOnly Goody Svix webhook. HTTP POST /v1/webhooks management is omitted.
